package_detail: Allwinner eLQFP-128 (E-PAD LQFP), body 14.0 x 14.0 mm, lead-tip span 16.0 x 16.0 mm, 0.40 mm pitch, height max 1.60 mm; datasheet drawing DB128-SW1 lists exposed-pad options 3.61 / 5.72 / 8.00 / 7.75x6.60 mm REF (datasheet does not say which applies to the V3s product code DB1283C; verify EPAD size against a physical part or the reference footprint before finalising copper)

epad.name: EPAD
epad.notes: Exposed pad is the only digital ground of the package (Table 3-1 lists no GND pins other than AGND). Must be soldered to GND with thermal vias (FunKey footprint: 3x3 vias on a 1 mm grid). KiCad symbols from Sipeed/FunKey/aep model it as pin 129 (EGND/GND).

cross_check: Primary source: Allwinner V3s Datasheet V1.0 Table 3-1 (pin characteristics, ball# + name) parsed programmatically, 128/128 pins, no gaps, no duplicates; visually checked against the datasheet Appendix pin map (p.419, top view, pin 1 = PG4, counter-clockwise: 1-32 left, 33-64 bottom, 65-96 right, 97-128 top, centre EPAD). Independent cross-checks of pin number vs primary pin name: Sipeed Lichee Pi Zero schematic (lichee_zero_Schematic.pdf, KiCad 5.1.6 export, sheet zero_CPU-SchDoc) symbol 'V3S-eLQFP128': 127/128 match (differences: pin 62 ds=VCC-DRAM11 vs VCC-DARM11; all are spelling typos, pin numbers agree); aep/kicad aep.lib symbol 'AllWinner-V3s(eLQFP-128)': 128/128 match; TobleMiner/OpenHomelabSwitch SoC_Allwinner.lib symbol 'Allwinner_V3S': 127/128 match (differences: pin 107 ds=PF0 vs PF0MS/SDC0_D1/JTAG_MS; all are spelling typos, pin numbers agree); TreeNewbeer/Coonix Allwinner.lib symbol 'V3s': 127/128 match (differences: pin 89 ds=EPHY_RXN vs EPHY-RTN; all are spelling typos, pin numbers agree); FunKey-Project/FunKey-S-Hardware FunKey.lib symbol 'V3S': 128/128 match. Note on independence: the Sipeed, FunKey and Coonix symbols share spelling conventions (SPI_MISO, JTAG_CK1, EGND) and are probably one lineage; aep and TobleMiner are separate transcriptions, so there are three independent symbol lineages plus the datasheet. FunKey-S production netlist (FunKey.net, ref U3) additionally confirms the power-rail assignment: pins 59-62,65-70,72,79 on +1V8, 19-21,25,26,38,47,51,56,58,64,80,88,108,126 on +1V25, 76 and 115 on +3V0, 12,29,50,57,85,93,104,109,122,127 on +3V3, 98 on +3V3_AO, 110/111 USB_N/P, 74/75 X24MOUT/X24MIN, 95 X32KOUT, 99 ~RESET, 100-107 SDC0/PF6, 63/71 SVREF, 116 AGND=GND.
